title: Projectile
description: Allows the entity to be a thrown entity.

angle_offset.description: Additional upwards pitch (in degrees) applied to the shooter's aim direction at launch. Negative values aim downward.

anchor.description: Reference point on the shooter used to position the projectile at spawn: `0` = origin (feet), `1` = eye height, `2` = middle of the bounding box.

catch_fire.description: Legacy default for whether the projectile sets the entity hit on fire. Prefer the `catch_fire` on-hit subcomponent.

crit_particle_on_hurt.description: If `true`, critical-hit particles are spawned on the projectile when it is struck.

destroy_on_hurt.description: If `true`, the projectile is removed from the world when struck.

filter.description: Entity Definitions defined here can't be hurt by the projectile.

fire_affected_by_griefing.description: If true, whether the projectile causes fire is affected by the mob griefing game rule.

gravity.description: Downward acceleration (blocks per tick squared) applied each tick while in flight. Higher values make the projectile fall faster.

hit_sound.description: Identifier of the sound to play when the projectile hits an entity. Also used for block hits when `hit_ground_sound` is not specified.

hit_ground_sound.description: Identifier of the sound to play when the projectile hits a block. Defaults to `hit_sound` when empty.

hit_nearest_passenger.description: If `true`, when the projectile hits a vehicle with at least one passenger, the on-hit behavior is applied to the passenger closest to the impact point instead of the vehicle itself.

homing.description: If `true`, the projectile steers towards an active target while in flight.

ignored_entities.description: Array of entity identifiers that the projectile will pass through without registering a hit.

inertia.description: Fraction of the projectile's velocity preserved each tick while traveling through air. Values below `1.0` cause it to slow down over time.

is_dangerous.description: If `true`, the projectile is flagged as dangerous, affecting AI reactions and certain client-side behaviors.

isolated_physics.description: If `true`, the projectile uses a dedicated ballistic physics path and ignores generic actor movement systems (friction, drag, etc.). Recommended for custom projectiles.

knockback.description: If true, the projectile will knock back the entity it hits.

lightning.description: If `true`, the projectile can channel a lightning bolt when it hits an entity during a thunderstorm.

liquid_inertia.description: Fraction of the projectile's velocity preserved each tick while traveling through a fluid.

multiple_targets.description: If `true`, the projectile can hit more than one entity over the course of its flight; if `false`, it stops at the first entity it hits.

offset.description: Offset, relative to the `anchor`, at which the projectile is spawned when fired by the shooter.

on_fire_time.description: Duration in seconds for which an entity set on fire by this projectile remains burning. Applied both by the legacy top-level `catch_fire` flag and by the `catch_fire` on-hit subcomponent.

on_hit.description: Map of on-hit subcomponents that drive what happens when the projectile impacts a block, fluid, or entity. Each key is a subcomponent name and its value is the subcomponent's configuration.

arrow_effect.description: Variant of `mob_effect` that derives the effects from the arrow's tipped-potion data and splits durations across the standard eight-arrow stack.

apply_effect_to_blocking_targets.description: If `true`, effects are still applied to targets that blocked the projectile.

catch_fire.description: Sets the hit entity on fire and, when the hit is on a block, can ignite nearby blocks. The burn duration is controlled by the projectile-level `on_fire_time` field.

fire_affected_by_griefing.description: If `true`, the block-ignition behavior is suppressed when the shooter is a mob and the `mobGriefing` game rule is off.

definition_event.description: Fires an entity event on the shooter, the projectile, the entity hit, and/or all entities in a splash radius.

affect_projectile.description: If `true`, the event is fired on the projectile entity itself.

affect_shooter.description: If `true`, the event is fired on the projectile's shooter.

affect_splash_area.description: If `true`, the event is fired on every entity within `splash_area` blocks of the impact.

affect_target.description: If `true`, the event is fired on the entity hit by the projectile.

event_trigger.description: Event trigger (with optional filters) to fire on the selected target(s).

douse_fire.description: When the projectile is a water-effect potion, extinguishes fires and campfires at and around the hit block.

grant_xp.description: Drops experience orbs at the impact location.

maxXp.description: Maximum amount of experience to drop.

minXp.description: Minimum amount of experience to drop.

hurt_owner.description: Damages the projectile's owner when the projectile lands.

ignite.description: If `true`, the damage sets the owner on fire.

knockback.description: If `true`, the damage applies knockback to the owner.

owner_damage.description: Amount of damage to deal to the owner.

ignite.description: Triggers the entity's `on_ignite` definition when the projectile hits.

impact_damage.description: Deals damage to the entity that was hit and optionally applies knockback, fire, channeling, and critical-hit scaling.

apply_knockback_to_blocking_targets.description: If `true`, knockback is still applied to targets that successfully blocked the hit.

catch_fire.description: If `true`, the entity hit is set on fire (uses the projectile's `on_fire_time`).

ceil_pre_critical_damage.description: If `true`, rounds the projectile's damage up to the next integer before the critical-hit multiplier is applied.

channeling.description: If `true`, the projectile can call down a lightning bolt on the entity hit during a thunderstorm.

damage.description: Range of damage to apply on impact. A random value in `[min, max]` is rolled per hit and the velocity-scaled `power_multiplier` term is added to it to define the projectile's base damage.

destroy_on_hit.description: If `true`, the projectile is removed when it deals damage to an entity.

destroy_on_hit_requires_damage.description: If `true`, `destroy_on_hit` only triggers when at least one point of damage is actually dealt (targets that fully absorb damage will not destroy the projectile).

difficulty_randomization.description: Controls how world difficulty contributes to the rolled damage. `none` ignores difficulty, `additive` adds a difficulty-driven term on top of the base damage, and `multiplicative` folds the difficulty term into `power_multiplier` before scaling by velocity.

filter.description: Entity family or type that the projectile is restricted to damaging. Entities outside the filter are not damaged.

knockback.description: If `true`, the entity hit is knocked back away from the projectile.

max_critical_damage.description: Upper bound of the bonus damage added when a critical hit lands.

min_critical_damage.description: Lower bound of the bonus damage added when a critical hit lands.

power_multiplier.description: Multiplied by the projectile's velocity and added to the rolled `damage` to define the projectile's base damage, so it can be used on its own to scale damage by the projectile's velocity.

semi_random_diff_damage.description: If true, damage will be randomized based on damage and speed

set_last_hurt_requires_damage.description: If `true`, the projectile only registers as the last hurt-by source on the target when at least one point of damage is actually dealt.

mob_effect.description: Applies one or more mob effects to the entity hit. Effects are described either with a single effect object or an `effects` array of effect objects.

effects.description: Array of effect objects. Each element may specify `effect` (name), `amplifier`, and per-difficulty durations `durationeasy`, `durationnormal`, `durationhard`.

particle_on_hit.description: Emits a particle effect at the impact location, optionally only for entity hits or only for non-entity hits.

num_particles.description: Number of particles to spawn per hit.

on_entity_hit.description: If `true`, particles are spawned when the projectile hits an entity.

on_other_hit.description: If `true`, particles are spawned when the projectile hits something that is not an entity.

particle_item_name.description: Map from item identifier to a filter group, used to select an item icon for `iconcrack`-style particles based on context (e.g. the projectile's owner).

particle_type.description: Particle type to spawn at the impact point.

remove_on_hit.description: Removes the projectile from the world when it hits a block, entity, or (if `hit_water` is set) water.

spawn_aoe_cloud.description: Spawns an area effect cloud at the impact point that applies potion effects to entities inside it over time

affect_owner.description: If `true`, the projectile's owner can be affected by the cloud.

duration.description: How long, in ticks, the cloud persists before disappearing.

particle.description: Particle effect emitted by the cloud.

potion.description: Aux value of the potion whose effects the cloud applies. When `-1`, the potion is taken from the projectile entity itself.

radius.description: Initial radius (in blocks) of the cloud.

radius_on_use.description: Amount the radius shrinks (or grows) each time the cloud applies its effects. `-1` keeps the radius unchanged.

reapplication_delay.description: Number of ticks the cloud waits before re-applying its effects to the same entity.

spawn_chance.description: Conditionally spawns one or two groups of entities at the impact location and optionally fires events on each spawned entity.

first_spawn_chance.description: Alternative to `first_spawn_percent_chance`: the first group spawns with a `1 / N` chance.

first_spawn_count.description: Number of entities spawned when the first roll succeeds.

first_spawn_percent_chance.description: Percent chance (0-100) that the first group spawns. Takes precedence over `first_spawn_chance`.

on_spawn.description: Array of entity event triggers to fire on each spawned entity.

second_spawn_chance.description: Alternative to `second_spawn_percent_chance`: the second group spawns with a `1 / N` chance.

second_spawn_count.description: Number of entities spawned when the second roll succeeds.

second_spawn_percent_chance.description: Percent chance (0-100) that the second group spawns (rolled independently of the first).

spawn_baby.description: If `true`, spawned entities start as babies (where applicable).

spawn_definition.description: Identifier of the entity definition to spawn.

stick_in_ground.description: Causes the projectile to embed itself in the block it hits.

shake_time.description: Duration in seconds for which the projectile visually shakes after sticking.

teleport_owner.description: Teleports the projectile's owner to the impact location.

thrown_potion_effect.description: Applies the splash-potion effects of a thrown potion to nearby entities at the impact point.

wind_burst_on_hit.description: Releases an outward wind burst at the impact point that pushes nearby entities away.

owner_launch_immunity_ticks.description: Number of ticks immediately after launch during which the projectile cannot hit its own shooter.

particle.description: Particle effect emitted at the impact location when the projectile hits something.

potion_effect.description: Default potion aux value associated with the projectile. Normally set programmatically by potion items; rarely useful at authoring time. A value matching the water potion is required for the `douse_fire` on-hit subcomponent to extinguish fires.

power.description: Initial speed (in blocks per tick) at which the projectile is launched.

reflect_immunity.description: Duration in seconds after launch during which the projectile cannot be reflected by being struck.

reflect_on_hurt.description: If `true`, the projectile reverses direction when struck, reflecting back towards the attacker.

semi_random_diff_damage.description: If true, damage will be randomized based on damage and speed

shoot_sound.description: Identifier of the sound to play when the projectile is fired.

shoot_target.description: If `true`, the projectile is aimed at the shooter's current target (when one exists) rather than straight ahead.

should_bounce.description: If `true`, the projectile bounces off surfaces and entities on impact instead of stopping.

splash_potion.description: If true, the projectile will be treated like a splash potion.

splash_range.description: Splash radius (in blocks) used when applying potion effects via the splash/lingering potion code path.

stop_on_hurt.description: If `true`, the projectile has its velocity zeroed out when struck.

uncertainty_base.description: Base inaccuracy added to the launch direction. The total inaccuracy is `uncertainty_base - difficultyLevel * uncertainty_multiplier`.

uncertainty_multiplier.description: Per-difficulty-level reduction in inaccuracy. See `uncertainty_base` for the full formula.
